set.name: Analytify/Friends feedback
set.description: Friends request lifecycle feedback. Loading gates actions; refreshing preserves cached content; busy prevents duplicate intent. Load failures retry reads. Mutation timeouts are unconfirmed: reconcile and retry the same single-use request. Unavailable invites require a new link. Verified Spotify identity is required. Announce loading/busy politely and failures as alerts; reduced motion removes decorative transitions. Owner unavailable requires explicit creation, never an automatic second invitation. Accepted/Declined are request-owned confirmed outcomes; success never grants private-data access.
